# simplelogin_alias (Resource)

Manages a SimpleLogin alias with an exact address on a verified custom domain, including its forwarding mailboxes, note, display name and enabled state.

~> **Deletion is effectively irreversible.** When an alias on a custom domain is deleted, SimpleLogin moves the address to the domain's trash and refuses to create the same address again while it is there. Destroying this resource, or changing `email` (which forces replacement), deletes the alias. Use `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` for addresses you depend on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplelogin_mailbox" "primary" {
  email = "personal@example.net"
}

resource "simplelogin_alias" "admin" {
  email       = "admin@example.com"
  mailbox_ids = [data.simplelogin_mailbox.primary.id]

  note    = "Administrative email alias"
  enabled = true

  # Deleting an alias moves its address to the SimpleLogin domain trash, and the
  # same address cannot be created again. Protect addresses you depend on.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Full alias address, e.g. `admin@example.com`. The domain must be a verified custom domain of the account. The local part must be 1-40 characters of lowercase `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_` or `-`, matching what SimpleLogin accepts. Changing this forces a new alias to be created and the old one to be **deleted**.
- `mailbox_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the verified mailboxes that receive mail for this alias. At least one is required. Use the `simplelogin_mailbox` data source to look up IDs.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alias forwards mail. Mail sent to a disabled alias is blocked instead of forwarded. Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (String) Display name used as the sender name when replying from the alias. At most 128 characters, no line breaks. Omit to leave it unset.
- `note` (String) Free-form note. Omit to keep the alias without a note; an empty string is not allowed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) SimpleLogin alias ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Import an existing alias by its SimpleLogin alias ID.
import {
  to = simplelogin_alias.admin
  id = "12345"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing alias by its SimpleLogin alias ID.
tofu import simplelogin_alias.admin 12345
```
